map.执行后自动生成解读。: Analysis appears after you run the tool.
map.下面的解读由本页面在你浏览器里对刚才的结果做本地分析得出，不上传、不调用额外接口: The analysis below is computed locally in your browser from the result you just got. Nothing is uploaded and no extra requests are made. For troubleshooting reference only, not a substitute for professional judgment.
map.尚未执行，点击上方按钮开始。: Not run yet. Click the button above to start.
map.最近一次成功结果只保存在你本机浏览器（localStorage），不上传。可展开: Your last successful result is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and is never uploaded. Expand a row to compare the current output with the previous one. Clearing site data removes the record.
map.以下工具与本页面常一起使用：: Tools commonly used with this page:
map.用公共 STUN 收集全部 ICE 候选，解析 IP / 类型 / 协议，列出内: Collect all ICE candidates via public STUN, parse IP/type/protocol, and list private and mDNS addresses.
map.通过 STUN 服务器让浏览器枚举所有 ICE 候选：host（本地）、srfl: Uses a STUN server to make the browser enumerate all ICE candidates: host (local), srflx (public mapping), etc. Leakage is flagged if WebRTC exposes your real public or private IP. Add ?stun= to customize; closes after 5s.
map.尚未检测。可先运行「公网 IP 查询」以获得对比基准。: Not checked yet. Run "Public IP Lookup" first for a comparison baseline.
map.尚未有运行记录，点击上方「检测泄露」开始。: No run history yet. Click "Check leak" above to start.
map.每个候选的 IP、类型与协议: Each candidate IP, type and protocol
map.host 类型暴露的局域网 IP: LAN IPs exposed by host candidates
map.即使使用代理/VPN，WebRTC 可能通过 STUN 绕过并暴露真实 IP，此: Even with a proxy/VPN, WebRTC may bypass it via STUN and reveal your real IP; this tool detects that.
map.检测到泄露怎么办？: What if a leak is found?
map.可在浏览器设置中禁用 WebRTC 或安装相关隐私扩展。: Disable WebRTC in browser settings or install a privacy extension.
map.STUN 服务器会记录我吗？: Does the STUN server log me?
map.公共 STUN 由第三方运营，理论上可看到你的公网 IP；可用 stun= 参数: Public STUN is run by third parties and can see your public IP; use stun= with a server you trust.
